mapper.select: SELECT attended_date, streak_after FROM point_attendance WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY attended_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_attendance (user_id, attended_date, awarded, streak_after) VALUES (#{userId}, #{attendedDate}, #{awarded}, #{streakAfter})
mapper.update: UPDATE linked_points lp JOIN linked_institutions li ON li.id = lp.institution_id JOIN institution_master im ON im.id = li.institution_master_id SET lp.balance = lp.balance + #{amount} WHERE lp.user_id = #{userId} AND im.company_code = 'SHINHAN_POINT' AND li.link_status = 'LINKED'
